intro.summary: St Cyril of Jerusalem was a 4th-century bishop and Doctor of the Church, remembered for his catechetical teachings and defense of the faith.

blocks.text: You can pray the full St Cyril of Jerusalem Novena below.
blocks.title: Introduction

parts.text: In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen. Strengthen, O God, your Church in the sacraments of your grace, that we, in union with the teaching and prayers of your servant Cyril of Jerusalem, may enter more fully into your Paschal mystery, through Jesus Christ our Lord, who lives and reigns with you and the Holy Spirit, one God, now and for ever. Amen. St Cyril, dauntless defender and teacher of the Catholic Faith against heretics and pagans, obtain for us the graces we need from God to form our intellects in His truth, through Christ our Lord. We also ask in particular for the intention of this novena

Amen. Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. Amen. Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee. Blessed art thou among women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen. Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit. As it was in the beginning, is now, and ever shall be, world without end. Amen. St Cyril of Jerusalem, pray for us! In the Name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.
